coordinator_note: Decision record only. The measurement harness (tools/perf_voices_*) and the startup getters for Apple's ALC_EXT_MAC_OSX settings stayed on the unmerged perf2/voices branch: they changed no shipped behaviour or timing, so 0.5.4 ships without them.

decision.accepted: startup diagnostic getters and reusable measurement tools only

mac.runner: GitHub macos-15-arm64, Apple silicon VM; not the owner Mac
mac.backend: Apple OpenAL.framework 1.1, Apple Computer Inc., Software

method.scenario: Existing rendering bot battle: 1280x800 window, 4800x1600 world, 36 grubs; combat, pan, discrete zoom, continuous zoom, separate real-context audio stress. Linux production combat fixture: 7 seconds, 2 cycles.
method.mac_pairing: Five interleaved rounds per workflow, fresh process per arm, unchanged journey and thresholds. Runs 1-6 include identical source-play FFI instrumentation in every arm; runs 7-8 omit it in every arm.
method.linux_pairing: Five 12/16/24 triples, five 12/14 pairs, five frozen-baseline/rejected-production24 pairs. Same Ruby and fixture in each pair.
method.statistics: n, median, nearest-rank p95 and min/max across captures; p95_ms denotes each capture frame-p95; over_33ms counts intervals greater than 33.4 ms.
method.acceptance: Primary improvement >=5% and >=80% paired direction (or nonoverlapping distributions), no guard regression beyond noise, correctness passes; Mac zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan at 12-voice control level across at least two workflows, plus fewer Linux combat steals.

diagnosis.source_path: OALSource::Play -> SetupMixerBus -> UpdateBusRenderQuality -> OALContext::SetSourceDesiredRenderQualityOnBus -> OALDevice::GetDesiredRenderChannelCount; stereo returns 2, multichannel queries HAL device/layout properties.
diagnosis.source_inspection_limits: Path comes from published source and agrees with timing-policy effect; not a native-stack sampling profile or proof of the zoom cause.

experiments.hypothesis: Allocated sources alone impose substantial mixer overhead.
experiments.change: Allocate 24 effects, cap the selector at 12 simultaneous effects.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Idle process CPU is effectively unchanged (0.418% at 12 vs 0.421% at 24). Zoom is noisy and only one workflow exists. Capping at 12 does not provide the required extra capacity.

experiments.hypothesis: Doubling the pool can meet the control rendering envelope without mixer tuning.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Run 8 reproduces slow zoom: medians 28.974/84.267 ms and 58 over-33 gaps vs 20.190/37.217 and 31. Runs 1 and 7 are faster but inconsistent; no reliable guard preservation.

experiments.hypothesis: High spatialization quality causes excess source-start or mixing cost.
experiments.change: 24 effects and explicit low rendering quality rdlo.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Apple already defaults to low. alSourcePlay median is unchanged (0.304 vs 0.301 ms); one workflow and no configuration-specific improvement.

experiments.hypothesis: Multichannel policy repeatedly queries HAL channel layouts on source start.
experiments.change: 24 effects, force stereo channel policy rcst before context creation, verify after context becomes current.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Source-play median drops 0.304 to 0.018 ms, with nonoverlapping capture medians and 5/5 pairs improving. Only one valid 24-voice workflow; strict combat/pan frame gates also failed in two candidate captures. No mixed-output correctness evidence.

experiments.hypothesis: Fewer mixer busses reduce scans of unused busses.
experiments.change: 24 effects plus music with maximum mixer busses 25, set before context creation.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Zoom median 22.557/52.079 vs 22.405/51.956 ms, within noise; idle CPU 0.408% vs 0.435%, playing24 1.343%. Two candidate rendering gates failed; no second qualifying run.

experiments.hypothesis: Matching 22.05 kHz assets reduces mixer/resampling work.
experiments.change: 24 effects and 22050 Hz mixer output rate before context creation.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Zoom median improves against an unusually slow control, but every candidate capture fails a rendering gate. Isolated idle CPU rises 0.543% to 0.785%; no repeat or mixed-output validation.

experiments.hypothesis: A lower mixer rate reduces per-voice CPU work.
experiments.change: 24 effects and 44100 Hz mixer output rate before context creation.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Zoom median mean improves only 3.7%, with overlapping/noisy distributions. Idle CPU 0.764% and playing24 1.722%; no repeat or mixed-output validation.

experiments.hypothesis: Two additional effect voices remove the fixture steals with smaller Mac cost.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Linux 6 to 0 steals in 5/5 pairs, but Mac zoom p95 medians reverse: 50.166 to 48.418 ms in run 5, 49.595 to 60.624 ms in run 6. The second median exceeds the historical control envelope.

experiments.hypothesis: A moderately larger pool is cheaper than 24 sources while removing steals.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: Linux 6 to 0 steals in 5/5 pairs, but run 6 zoom mean/p95/over-33 rises from 22.044/49.595/44 to 28.473/81.242/67.

experiments.hypothesis: The promising stereo benchmark translates to verified production initialization.
experiments.change: Proposed runtime MAX_VOICES=24 with stereo verification and 12-source fallback.
experiments.metric: Linux combat steals; Mac whole-stage zoom mean/p95/over-33 and combat/pan guards
experiments.reason: INVALID AS 24-VOICE CONFIRMATION: getter runs before alcMakeContextCurrent, returns zero and triggers the 12-effect fallback. All completed candidate captures and isolated probes allocated 12. No valid second 24-voice stereo run remains in the eight-run allowance.

experiments.hypothesis: Startup-only read-only mixer properties make future Mac evidence interpretable at negligible cost.
experiments.change: Log quality, channel policy, bus limit and mixer rate once when startup diagnostics are enabled. No setters, extra voices or gameplay calls.
experiments.metric: Repeated getter-report batch average, microseconds/call; 5 batches of 100 calls per process.
experiments.reason: Brief explicitly permits negligible diagnostic overhead. Control medians 7.03 and 15.78 microseconds/call; maximum batch averages 21.62 and 27.43 microseconds. Zero normal-game calls when logging is disabled; getters run after the context is current. This is observability, not a performance improvement.

7.missing_reason: Focus/setup timeouts; not silently omitted from workflow verdict.

limits: No configuration passed the requested acceptance bar; this does not prove a qualifying configuration cannot exist.
Eight workflow runs were used. Stereo confirmations in runs 7 and 8 accidentally measured 12 effects; never treat them as 24-source evidence.
Run 7 lost one default24 and three stereo captures to focus/setup timeouts; all failures remain in the workflow verdict.
Only workflow 6 passed every child rendering gate. Retained JSON includes failed-gate captures; controls can also be slow. No gates were relaxed.
The whole-stage zoom interval includes intentionally skipped idle paints. Active-motion intervals are steadier, but they do not replace the requested acceptance metric.
alSourcePlay timings and published source identify a HAL-layout-query path; no sampled native stacks were collected and the exact zoom causal mechanism remains unproven.
Process CPU covers all threads in the Ruby GUI process, not the native renderer, host, terrain worker, or total system CPU.
The isolated looping probe directly plays its requested source count; playing_limit only caps the game selector, not that diagnostic probe.

Runs 7 and 8 stopped the PCM probe at an absent ALC_EXT_OUTPUT_CAPTURER advertisement. Published source exports capture entry points without advertising the name. Revised pointer-based probe is syntax-checked only, not Mac-executed.
No mixed Mac PCM, acoustic latency, audible quality, device switching, surround/headphone or owner-M3-Pro acceptance evidence exists for these tuning candidates.
Getter overhead measures repeated-call batch averages, not a full cold-start comparison.
Linux null-driver steal counts and estimated truncated durations do not measure Mac hardware output or audible cutoffs.
Fixtures and sound-design scheduling are unchanged. No production rendering, simulation, wire, asset, or version changes were accepted.

unmeasured_proposal.change: Configure/verify stereo after alcMakeContextCurrent and before source allocation, assert actual pool and stereo mode, rerun two Mac workflows and mixed-output validation before considering acceptance.
